purpose: Ten-platform competitive benchmark for permanent product decisions. Each stance is Copy (adopt pattern), Improve (keep intent, raise the bar), or Avoid (anti-pattern).

platforms.name: PropStream
platforms.summary: Fast list pull + skip-trace packaging that operators already trust for sourcing.
copy: Distress signal tags that map to operator language
Export that survives re-ingest without inventing new primary keys
improve: Attach source provenance to every imported field
Refuse silent overwrite when a second list disagrees
avoid: Bundling outreach sends into the list pull

platforms.name: BatchLeads
platforms.summary: High-velocity list + dialer stack optimized for volume outreach.
copy: Clear distress filters that operators can explain
Campaign-ready exports with stable contact rows
improve: Separate sourcing from action — never auto-dial from intake
Surface conflicting owner/phone facts instead of picking a winner
avoid: Volume metrics that reward unsafe contact attempts

platforms.name: DealMachine
platforms.summary: Field-first capture that keeps the operator in the loop while driving.
copy: Capture that preserves who recorded the observation and when
improve: Normalize field notes without stripping provenance
Queue conflicts when assessor data disagrees with drive-by
avoid: Gamified lead counts that ignore underwriting readiness

platforms.name: PropertyRadar
platforms.summary: Deep property/event intelligence with strong filter grammar.
copy: Event timelines that make distress narrative reviewable
Filter language that maps to underwriting questions
improve: Keep competing event interpretations visible until operator resolve
Price underwriting honesty above dashboard density
avoid: Dense charts that compress uncertainty into a single score

platforms.name: FreedomSoft
platforms.summary: Wholesale CRM with pipeline stages and buyer matching.
copy: Explicit pipeline stages that match wholesale language
Buyer-box matching as an operator-assisted step
improve: Typed states that refuse illegal transitions
Assignment / offer actions require explicit operator decision
avoid: Stage theater that auto-advances without evidence

platforms.name: REI BlackBook
platforms.summary: Long-running wholesale CRM with marketing automation hooks.
copy: Persistent deal records across long cycles
Buyer relationship memory that survives campaign churn
improve: Marketing automation stays behind the action boundary
Audit trail for every automated vs human decision
avoid: Marketing drip that pretends to be underwriting

platforms.name: InvestorFuse
platforms.summary: Ops automation that often collapses review into templated sends.
improve: Checklists as evidence prompts, not silent pass gates

platforms.name: Podio / Airtable DIY
platforms.summary: Flexible DIY ops boards teams already understand.
copy: Operator-visible fields with no hidden score engine
improve: Add typed transitions and provenance without losing transparency
Replace spreadsheet formulas that fabricate ARVs
avoid: Unbounded schema drift with no conflict model

platforms.name: Spreadsheet chaos
platforms.summary: The default competitor: shared sheets with silent edits and no provenance.
improve: Keep inspectability while adding typed state and audit events
avoid: Silent cell overwrite as the conflict model
No distinction between source fact and operator decision

platforms.name: ListSource / CoreLogic-style pulls
platforms.summary: Vendor list pulls that feed authorized intake when treated as evidence, not truth.
copy: Stable vendor record IDs for re-ingest idempotency
Clear field dictionaries that can be cited in review
improve: Label every field with vendor + pull timestamp
avoid: Treating vendor enrichment as operator-verified fact
Building outreach on first pull without distress validation
